posts.title: When hobbies collide and spiral.
posts.description: The heatwave knocked me out. My fibro does not like heat. Neither does the meniere's. So as soon as the heatwave was over I was into 4 days of migraine flare up, tinnitus being stupidly loud and my ear feeling like someone has syringed too much water into it.
